title: Provide reusable asynchronous scoring and integration hosting stacks
description: Implement immutable-image async scoring plus configurable request-state, authenticated API hosting, and response-worker infrastructure while keeping runtime handlers consumer-owned.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented digest-only asynchronous scoring and generic authenticated API/response hosting while leaving runtime handlers, routes, environment bindings, and data behavior consumer-owned.
